authorization: Continue the bounded connected-cluster feasibility branch after both global omitted-mass relaxations failed.
question: Does the exact local current kernel admit a uniformly controlled connected-cumulant representation whose error controls the full LER functional in Fourier l1 norm?
frozen_model: Same ternary edge kernel K(phi)=1-p+pq exp(i phi)+p(1-q) exp(-i phi), E=32 L5 square, logical twist and measured-charge Fourier projection.

method.banach_space: Multivariate Wiener algebra of absolutely summable Fourier coefficients; twists preserve its norm and charge projection/grouping is l1-contractive.
method.factorization: K=(1-p)(1+z S), z=p/(1-p), S=q exp(i phi)+(1-q)exp(-i phi), with ||S||_A=1.
method.full_graph_bound: For F=product_e K_e and F_N=(1-p)^E exp(sum_e P_N(zS_e)), ||F-F_N||_A<=exp(E r_N)-1 because ||F||_A=1.
method.LER_bound: The same bound controls the twisted projected coefficient l1 error, hence |LER_N-LER|<=[exp(E r_N)-1]/2. This is a deterministic approximation error, not sampling uncertainty.

matrix.q: bound is uniform for all q in [0,1]

acceptance: Verify the scalar log remainder and product bound numerically on a deterministic phase grid while retaining the analytic Wiener proof as the claim basis.
Promote feasibility at a p value only if some registered N gives absolute LER error <=0.001. Record the smallest such N.
Distinguish representation control from evaluability: this contract does not claim LER_N has yet been contracted on L5.
No decoder, threshold, phase, CFT or fitted-curve claim.
stop_rule: Stop after the frozen error-budget matrix. If p=.08 is feasible, register finite-harmonic evaluation of F_N next; if not, reject this cumulant route at the registered accuracy.
decision: Promote the Wiener connected-cumulant representation to finite-harmonic evaluation. On the L5 E=32 square, the q-uniform absolute LER error is <=.001 at p=.08 with N=3, p=.10 with N=3 and p=.30 with N=10.
next_action: Register a finite-harmonic approximation to exp(P_N) with an additional certified Wiener tail, contract the twisted charge coefficients, and report LER_N with the combined deterministic error.
